shared_elements: bearded human figures in strict profile
elaborately curled/beaded hair and beard rendered as regular rows
figures facing one another / arranged in a row
carved low-relief figural frieze with linear incised detail
justification: Both show low-relief profile human figures with the same distinctive conventions — tightly rowed curls of hair and beard, long fringed robes, hands raised holding small objects, and figures facing each other in a horizontal procession-like register — which is a fairly specific shared repertoire rather than generic 'people'. The main differences are in content: B is a two-figure confrontation centred on a raised bowl with an inscribed text panel across the garments, while A includes a horse's head, a chariot/vehicle with harness fittings and a lower band of rosette-like discs, so the actual scenes depicted differ.
